alternatives.option: the field's proposed rebucketing for D15

context: Built the two D15-derived fixes TDD: promote attribution (promoted_by/promoted_at stamped on ratification, additive already_active_detail on the result) and unarchive assumption reporting (assumed_active + warning-typed post for marker-less pre-2.7 archives). 1629 tests green. D14 investigation still running.
rationale: reclassifying previously-promoted ids under 'promoted' would claim a call ratified what it did not touch, falsifying the audit trail; detail carries promoted_by/promoted_at so a prior ratification is distinguishable from active-since-creation, and existing consumers of already_active keep their contract (PROMOTE-02 added to BEHAVIORS).
summary: Chose an ADDITIVE already_active_detail field over the field's proposed rebucketing for D15
